snippet.title: Dungeon Delights SAGE 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
The SAGE 2026 demo for Dungeon Delights is out now! A bit late for the start of SAGE, but I was waiting for most of the voice lines to come in first.

https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/dungeon-delights-sage-2026-demo.3278/

- Trailer Music -
Josh Kashdan (Kashdan Music)

- Voice Actors -
Office Recording Guy: Candescence

Hayley, Lilith: Shelley Hunter

Mirza: Brenna Escamilla

Adam, Galriuz, Belphegor: Josh Kashdan
